verdicts.originalText: The shield value shown is Level 1 (Ad Lib) — the strength you always get, from hitting 0–1 opponents. Hitting 2 opponents raises it to Level 2 (Lead-In) and 3+ opponents to Level 3 (Rave), each absorbing progressively more; Level 3 also deals periodic Pyro DMG to nearby foes. The first ascension passive lowers those thresholds to 1 and 2 opponents. The shield also absorbs Pyro DMG 2.5x more effectively (not reflected in the value).
verdicts.proposedText: Shown at its lowest strength, from hitting 0–1 opponents; hitting 2 or 3+ opponents gives progressively stronger shields that aren't reflected. Not modeled: the top tier's periodic Pyro DMG, and the shield's extra effectiveness against Pyro DMG.
verdicts.rationale: Legitimate divergence: the timeline paints the shield at its unconditional floor (Level 1), but the higher opponent-count tiers can't be modeled (no enemy-count primitive), so a player would over-read the shown value. The original ran 4 sentences / ~435ch, breaking the 2-sentence limit and nearing the hard cap. Compressed to the decision-relevant core (shown value is the minimum; more opponents = stronger, unreflected) plus the two genuine omissions (top-tier Pyro DoT, better Pyro absorption). Tier proper-names, the exact 2.5x figure, and the A1 threshold detail (already surfaced as its own passive panel entry) demoted to curator notes.
demotedNotes: Caveat tier names dropped for length: Level 1 Ad Lib (0–1 opponents hit), Level 2 Lead-In (2 opponents), Level 3 Rave (3+ opponents).
A1 ascension passive lowers the Level 2 / Level 3 opponent thresholds to 1 and 2; it is already surfaced as its own passive panel entry, so it was dropped from the skill caveat to avoid duplication.
Pyro absorption effectiveness is 2.5x (250% DMG Absorption vs Pyro per skill description); exact multiplier demoted, qualitative 'extra effectiveness against Pyro' claim retained.
